planParisTrip.title: Plan
planParisTrip.subtitle: a trip to Paris
planParisTrip.body: I want to plan a 7-day trip to Paris. Please suggest must-see attractions, recommend good neighborhoods to stay in, and create a daily itinerary including restaurants and activities.

beginMeditating.title: Begin
beginMeditating.subtitle: meditating
beginMeditating.body: I'm interested in starting a meditation practice. Please guide me through basic meditation techniques, suggest a daily routine, and explain the benefits for mental well-being.

designWorkoutRoutine.title: Design
designWorkoutRoutine.subtitle: a workout routine
designWorkoutRoutine.body: I'd like to design a home workout routine without equipment. Please create a balanced exercise plan that targets all major muscle groups, including warm-up and cool-down stretches.

pickWeekendActivity.title: Pick
pickWeekendActivity.subtitle: a weekend activity
pickWeekendActivity.body: Options for a free Saturday: 1. Hiking: Great weather, but a long drive. 2. Movie marathon: Relaxing but indoors all day. 3. Local event: Social but unpredictable. Choose the best activity based on energy levels and mood.

packLight.title: Pack
packLight.subtitle: light for a weekend trip
packLight.body: A 3-day trip allows only a carry-on bag. Pack essentials, including versatile outfits, toiletries, and necessary gadgets, while keeping luggage minimal.

organizeFinances.title: Organize
organizeFinances.subtitle: my finances
organizeFinances.body: I want to get my personal finances organized. Please help me create a monthly budget, track my expenses, and suggest practical strategies for saving money.

tellMeSomethingFascinating.title: Tell me
tellMeSomethingFascinating.subtitle: something fascinating
tellMeSomethingFascinating.body: Share an interesting scientific discovery or historical fact that most people don't know about. Please explain why it's significant and its impact on our understanding.

prepareJobInterview.title: Prepare
prepareJobInterview.subtitle: for a job interview
prepareJobInterview.body: An interview is scheduled for a marketing position. Research common questions, prepare answers, and choose professional attire to make a strong impression.

writeProfessionally.title: Write
writeProfessionally.subtitle: professionally
writeProfessionally.body: I need to write a formal email to decline a business proposal while maintaining good relationships. Please help me craft a polite and professional message.

startLearningFrench.title: Start learning
startLearningFrench.subtitle: French
startLearningFrench.body: I want to start learning French. Could you create a beginner-friendly study plan with daily exercises, recommended resources, and practical conversation starters?

planVacationTrip.title: Plan
planVacationTrip.subtitle: a vacation trip
planVacationTrip.body: A 5-day trip to Italy includes stops in Rome and Florence. Balance sightseeing, relaxation, and local food experiences while considering travel time between cities.

explainComplexTopic.title: Explain
explainComplexTopic.subtitle: a complex topic simply
explainComplexTopic.body: Could you explain how quantum computing works in simple terms? Please use everyday analogies and avoid technical jargon.

organizeBirthdayParty.title: Organize
organizeBirthdayParty.subtitle: a birthday party
organizeBirthdayParty.body: A birthday party is planned for 10 guests with a $400 budget. Allocate funds for food, decorations, and entertainment while keeping costs under control.

summarizeText.title: Summarize
summarizeText.subtitle: this text
summarizeText.body: Could you please provide a concise summary of this text, highlighting the main points and key takeaways? Focus on the most important information while maintaining the core message.

decideDinner.title: Decide
decideDinner.subtitle: what to cook for dinner
decideDinner.body: The fridge contains chicken, bell peppers, rice, and a few spices. Create a quick and tasty meal using these ingredients without requiring a grocery trip.

discoverNextBook.title: Discover
discoverNextBook.subtitle: my next book
discoverNextBook.body: Based on my interest in fiction novels with strong character development and psychological themes, could you recommend some books? I recently enjoyed works by Donna Tartt and Haruki Murakami.

boostProductivity.title: Boost
boostProductivity.subtitle: my productivity
boostProductivity.body: I need help creating a balanced daily schedule that maximizes my productivity while maintaining work-life balance. Please include time management tips and suggested breaks.
